headline: Waived impact fees for 32 affordable units at 275 Jewett Street; denied other fee waivers; continued Wellington Road and Bremer Street subdivisions.
summary: Public hearings on a 34-lot subdivision on Wellington Road and a subdivision at 4 Bremer Street were continued. For 275 Jewett Street, impact fees were waived for 32 affordable units, and the other waiver requests were denied. The meeting also approved the August 5, 2026 minutes and nominated three people for reappointment to the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission.
decisions: Continued the public hearing on the Wellington Road subdivision, S2026-005, to October 1, 2026.
Found applications IMP2026-001, S2026-016, and S2024-11 Extension complete and ordered public hearings; motion carried.
Continued the public hearing on the 4 Bremer Street subdivision, S2026-016; discussion set for September 17, 2026.
Waived impact fees for the 32 affordable units; motion carried.
Denied the fee waiver for the four market-rate units and denied the fire impact fee waiver; motion carried.
Approved the minutes of the August 5, 2026 meeting as written; motion carried.
Nominated Ray Clement, Peter Capano, and Alderman Dan O’Neil for reappointment to the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission; motion carried.
Agreed not to bring the 907 Second Street McDonald's landscape changes back before the Board.

decision_evidence.quote: The Chair continued the public hearing for S2026-005 to October 1, 2026.

The Vice Chair moved that, with respect to the following applications, appropriate materials have been submitted to invoke the jurisdiction of the Planning Board ... the following applications are complete and a Public Hearing should be conducted: IMP2026-001; S2026-016; S2024-11 - Extension, which was seconded by Mr. Beaupre. ... (Motion Carried)
The Chair continued the public hearing for S2026-016 and stated that the Board will discuss this item at their meeting on September 17, 2026.

The Vice Chair moved to waive the impact fees for the 32 affordable units and waive only those fees; the Board denies the request to waive the fees on the four market-rate units and denies the request to waive the fire impact fees which was seconded by Mr. Beaupre. ... (Motion Carried)

The Vice Chair moved to waive the impact fees for the 32 affordable units and waive only those fees; the Board denies the request to waive the fees on the four market-rate units and denies the request to waive the fire impact fees which was seconded by Mr. Beaupre. ... (Motion Carried)
Mr. Morrow moved to approve the Planning Board minutes of August 5, 2026, as written, which was seconded by the Vice Chair. ... (Motion Carried)

Mr. Winslow moved to nominate Ray Clement, Peter Capano, and Alderman Dan O’Neil for reappointment to the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission for four-year terms to expire on June 30, 2030, which was seconded by Mr. Beaupre. ... (Motion Carried)
There was agreement on the Board to not bring the McDonald’s back before the Board.
